items.informal_name: Set Supremum Equals Image of Binary Suprema
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : SemilatticeSup α] (s t : Set α), Set.image2 (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊔ x2) s t = s ⊻ t
items.informal_description: For any sets $s$ and $t$ over a sup-semilattice $\alpha$, the supremum of $s$ and $t$ (denoted $s \sqcup t$) is equal to the image of the binary supremum operation $\sqcup$ applied to all pairs $(a, b) \in s \times t$. Formally, $\{a \sqcup b \mid a \in s, b \in t\} = s \sqcup t$.

items.informal_name: Indexed Union of Suprema Images Equals Set Supremum
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : SemilatticeSup α] (s t : Set α), ⋃ a ∈ s, (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊔ x2) a '' t = s ⊻ t
items.informal_description: The indexed union over all elements $ a \in s $ of the image of $ t $ under the supremum operation with $ a $ is equal to the set of all suprema $ a \sqcup b $ where $ a \in s $ and $ b \in t $. Formally, $ \bigcup_{a \in s} \{ a \sqcup b \mid b \in t \} = \{ a \sqcup b \mid a \in s, b \in t \} $.

items.informal_name: Supremum of Image of Binary Function Equals Double Supremum
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : CompleteLattice α] {f : β → γ → α} {s : Set β} {t : Set γ},
  sSup (Set.image2 f s t) = ⨆ a ∈ s, ⨆ b ∈ t, f a b
items.informal_description: In a complete lattice $\alpha$, for any binary function $f : \beta \to \gamma \to \alpha$ and subsets $s \subseteq \beta$, $t \subseteq \gamma$, the supremum of the image of $f$ over $s \times t$ is equal to the double supremum of $f(a, b)$ for all $a \in s$ and $b \in t$. Formally, $\sup(f[s \times t]) = \sup_{a \in s} \sup_{b \in t} f(a, b)$.

items.informal_name: Supremum operation on sets via binary join
items.informal_description: The HasSups instance for the type of subsets of $\alpha$ is defined by taking the image of the binary supremum operation $\sqcup$ over all pairs of elements from the set. For any two subsets $s$ and $t$, their supremum is the set $\{a \sqcup b \mid a \in s, b \in t\}$.

items.informal_name: Supremum of Binary Image Set Equals Iterated Suprema Over Left Set
items.informal_description: Let $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$, and $\delta$ be types, with $\alpha$ and $\beta$ equipped with a sup-semilattice structure. For a binary function $f : \alpha \to \beta \to \gamma$, a function $g : \gamma \to \delta$, and non-empty finite sets $s \subseteq \alpha$, $t \subseteq \beta$, the supremum of $g$ applied to the image set $\{f(a,b) \mid a \in s, b \in t\}$ is equal to the supremum over $s$ of the suprema of $g(f(a,b))$ for each fixed $a \in s$ over $b \in t$. Symbolically: $\sup'_{a \in s} \left( \sup'_{b \in t} g(f(a,b)) \right) = \sup'_{(a,b) \in s \times t} g(f(a,b))$.
